subject: Delivery timing for the display
text:
Hi,

Could you help arrange the replacement display for the second-floor meeting room? I checked the vendor quote again, and an unanticipated expense has appeared. They added an out-of-hours handling fee because the lift will be reserved during standard work time. I would rather not let that surprise us after approval, so please let me know if we can receive the delivery during normal hours.

If that is not possible, I can request a small exception budget. However, I need the revised figure and the likely delivery window before noon. I will copy the operations desk so we can clear the corridor and keep the entrance accessible.

Please tell me if you prefer to coordinate this directly with the courier. I am happy to share the vendor contact and the room booking reference once you are available.

Thanks,
